constraints: THE CHECKER IS COPIED VERBATIM AND THIS IS THE LOAD-BEARING CONSTRAINT. Extract the CTRL-4 checking code from the COMMITTED BATCH-015 probe_driver.py, copy it into mutation_driver.py UNCHANGED except for the function signature and input binding, LIST EVERY CHANGED CHARACTER in mutation_manifest.json, and record the SHA-256 of the copied text together with the source path, line range and commit. A REWRITTEN CHECKER MEASURES THE REWRITE, NOT CTRL-4, AND WOULD MAKE THIS CARD VACUOUS IN EXACTLY THE WAY IT EXISTS TO DETECT. If the checker cannot be isolated, STOP AND REPORT THAT AS A FINDING; do not substitute your own.

THE COMMITTED HARNESS IS THE OBJECT OF MEASUREMENT AND IS NEVER MODIFIED. Do not edit, patch, monkey-patch in a way that persists, or `fix` anything under harness/. EVERY MUTATION IS APPLIED TO A RETURNED LIST OR TO AN ARGUMENT PASSED IN, NEVER BY EDITING HARNESS CODE. If a harness defect blocks a case, RECORD IT AND STOP THAT CASE - a repair requires a versioned protocol amendment and this card has none.

NEVER CALL harness.endomorphism_la.main(), in process or as a subprocess, and NEVER CALL _measure_displacement_rank, _collect_relations, _build_random_factor_base or harness.runner.write_run. They compute quantities this card is forbidden to compute.

RUN CASE 0, THE UNMUTATED BASELINE, FIRST AND REPORT IT AS AN INSTRUMENT SANITY CHECK AND NOT AS A RESULT. If the baseline does not report PASS on both conditions, RECORD THAT THE MUTATION HARNESS IS BROKEN, mark every mutated case `not_interpretable`, and STOP INTERPRETING - you may still execute the mutated cases and report their raw outcomes, but the manifest must state that no conclusion is drawn from them.

CASE (1): FOR EACH OF z = 5 AND z = 1234, COMPUTE pow(z, 3, p) YOURSELF AND REPORT IT before building anything; the red team's quoted cubes 125 and 1799 are PRIOR-RECORD FIGURES TO CHECK, NOT TO ADOPT, and a disagreement IS A FINDING. If pow(z, 3, p) == 1 for either z on the computed p, that z is NOT a valid mutation and the case is reported INVALID for that z rather than scored. Build the factor base WITH that z and evaluate the checker WITH THE SAME z, exactly as the red team did.

CASE (1)'s OUTCOME IS PRE-STATED AS PASS AND IS NOT A PREDICTION YOU SCORE. IT IS ALREADY THE COMMITTED FINDING OF TASK-20260730-034. YOU MAY NOT RECORD ITS REPRODUCTION AS A NEW RESULT, AS A DISCOVERY OR AS EVIDENCE ABOUT PHI-INVARIANCE. If it does NOT reproduce, that is a DISCREPANCY AGAINST A COMMITTED RECORD and is reported as a finding, not as a new discovery.

CASE (2): replace EXACTLY ONE element, G[1] - block j = 0, position k = 1 - of a copy of the true-zeta3 factor base at B = 192. Choose the replacement x BY THE STATED DETERMINISTIC RULE: scan x = 1, 2, 3, ... upward and take the FIRST x with E.lift_x(x) not None, x not in F, and x not equal to pow(zeta3, t, p) * F[0] % p for t in {0, 1, 2}. RECORD THE CHOSEN x, THE RULE AND THE NUMBER OF CANDIDATES SCANNED. If no such x exists, STOP AND REPORT - do not weaken the rule and do not choose a different index.

CASE (3): interleave EXACTLY the two named blocks of a copy of the true-zeta3 factor base at B = 192 so that H[0..5] = [F[0], F[3], F[1], F[4], F[2], F[5]] and every other index is unchanged. NO element is added, removed or altered. DO NOT CHOOSE A DIFFERENT PERMUTATION: it is fixed in this queue before the card exists, so that no outcome can be obtained by choosing a permutation after seeing a result.

REPORT BOTH CTRL-4 CONDITIONS SEPARATELY FOR EVERY CASE, PLUS THE JOINT PASS/FAIL. Condition (i) is len(F) == B with the observed length beside it; condition (ii) is the block identity. THE JOINT RESULT IS PASS ONLY IF BOTH PASS. A case that fails condition (ii) while passing condition (i) is reported exactly that way and never blurred into one verdict.

REPORT SETS, NOT BARE COUNTS (PRED-ID-STR). On every condition-(ii) failure, emit the FULL SORTED LIST OF FAILING (j, k) PAIRS with the offending values - never a count alone. Where you report a count, say it is a count and give its generating rule. A cardinality agreement with a different member set is `cardinality_only_agreement` and is NOT reported as agreement. DO NOT PREDICT WHICH PAIRS WILL FAIL; REPORT WHICH DID.

COMPUTE EVERY INSTANCE PARAMETER; TRANSCRIBE NONE. p, n, a, b, zeta3, curve_id and the derived seed are computed from the committed generator and recorded. NO instance parameter may be hardcoded or supplied on the command line. The prior-record figures p = 2293, n = 733 and derived seed 100 MAY BE QUOTED BESIDE the computed values LABELLED AS PRIOR-RECORD FIGURES; A MISMATCH IS A FINDING TO REPORT, never a defect to fix and never grounds for overriding the computed value.

COMPUTE NO CLOSURE, NO ALPHA, NO PHI_ALPHA, NO DISPLACEMENT RANK, NO MISALIGNMENT SET, NO PREDICTED SET, NO rank_M, NO RANK DEFICIENCY, NO BRANCH DETERMINATION, NO F-1 TO F-5 VERDICT, NO LADDER STATEMENT, NO SCALING LAW, NO RELATION, NO SUPPLY COUNT AND NO COST QUANTITY OF ANY KIND. DO NOT APPEND OR SHIFT ANY ROW. The ONLY permutation you perform is the fixed six-element interleaving of CASE (3), which is a mutation of an input list and not a row operation.

THE WALL-CLOCK AND MEMORY FIGURES YOU RECORD ARE BUDGET ACCOUNTING, NOT COST QUANTITIES. Record them per case in distinct non-overlapping windows and state in mutation_manifest.json that they are budget accounting and are not a cost measurement, a comparison or a baseline.

EVALUATE THE PRE-REGISTERED CONSEQUENCE MECHANICALLY AND INTERPRET IT NOT AT ALL. Record `assertion_passed_a_mutated_case` as true or false in mutation_manifest.json, computed by exactly this rule and no other: it is true if the JOINT PASS/FAIL is PASS for case (1) at either z, or for case (2), or for case (3). NAME every contributing case. WRITE NO INTERPRETATION, NO RECOMMENDATION AND NO DISPOSITION - those belong to the reviews and to the Coordinator. In particular DO NOT WRITE that CTRL-4 is retired or rewritten; that is the Coordinator's decision at TASK-20260730-040.

A TIMED-OUT, CANCELLED OR FAILED CASE IS NOT A PASS AND IS NOT A FAIL AND IS NOT FED TO THE PRE-REGISTERED CONSEQUENCE IN EITHER DIRECTION. Record it with terminal status `failed_infrastructure` or `cancelled_by_budget`, valid false, and the invalid_reason. THAT IS INFRASTRUCTURE SIGNAL AND IS NEVER A NEGATIVE MATHEMATICAL RESULT (AGENTS.md core rule 5).

DETERMINISM CHECK: re-execute ALL FOUR CASES a second time in the same process and record a determinism PASS or FAIL with the compared values. A FAIL is a FINDING TO REPORT and invalidates the affected cases, not necessarily the whole card.

RUN THE PRE-FLIGHT DISK CHECK BEFORE THE FIRST WRITE and record the exact free-space figure in mutation_manifest.json. IF FREE SPACE IS BELOW 5 GiB, STOP AND REPORT AND WRITE NO MUTATION ARTIFACTS. The volume was reported at 99 percent with about 30 GiB free and git fsck has already timed out on it.

WALL-CLOCK CAPS: 120 s per case (case 0, case 1 at z = 5, case 1 at z = 1234, case 2, case 3, counted individually), 180 s for instance generation, 180 s for the determinism re-execution, 600 s TOTAL. A BREACH TERMINATES THAT UNIT AND IS RECORDED AS INFRASTRUCTURE SIGNAL with the terminal status recorded - NEVER as a PASS, NEVER as a FAIL, NEVER as a measurement and NEVER as a negative result about anything. An instance-generation breach stops the card entirely. On a TOTAL-cap breach, record every unstarted case as `cancelled_by_budget` and STOP AND REPORT A BOUNDED PARTIAL RESULT NAMING EXACTLY WHICH CASES YOU DID NOT REACH.

ARTIFACT-SIZE CAPS: 512 KiB per file, 2 MiB for the whole mutation directory. ON A PER-FILE CAP: write the sha256 of the offending structure, OMIT the full dump, record DEV-SIZE-1 NAMING THE EXACT CASES, and continue - NEVER write a truncated JSON document. ON THE TREE CAP: STOP and report which named cases were not reached.
WRITE ALL SEVEN DECLARED FILES EVEN FOR A PARTIAL, CANCELLED OR FAILED CARD, with the terminal status recorded in mutation_manifest.json. That is what makes the eight-path archive declaration exact.

CREATE NO RUN IDENTIFIER, WRITE NOTHING UNDER experiments/, AND DO NOT CALL harness.runner.write_run. This is not an experiment run and must not be archived as one (INT-BATCH016-F). Record mutation_manifest.json's `run_ids` as an empty list WITH the reason stated.

MAKE NO COMMIT. This card writes files; TASK-20260730-037 commits them and nothing else does. Write nothing under ledger/, knowledge/, harness/, tools/, experiments/, or any other batch directory. Never touch tools/validate_ledger_baseline.txt. Write no macOS AppleDouble sidecar file.

RECORD PROVENANCE HONESTLY: requested_policy from this handoff, the actually resolved model, model_verified false with its reason, fallback_used set honestly, and session independence asserted. NO SUBSTITUTION IS MADE SILENTLY (INT-BATCH016-D).
BOUNDED CARD: 600 seconds total, 1 GB memory. If you cannot finish inside the cap, STOP AND REPORT A BOUNDED PARTIAL RESULT. Do not overrun silently and do not compress by fabricating a figure.

NO RECORD IN THIS PROGRAM CURRENTLY DISTINGUISHES THOSE TWO STATES.

objective: BATCH-016 DISPATCHES CTRL-RT034-A ALONE - THE MUTATION TEST OF CTRL-4 - AS A SINGLE EXECUTOR CARD, PLUS THE STANDARD ARCHIVE-AND-REVIEW CHAIN (snapshot archive ALONE, two independent reviews concurrently, ledger archive ALONE), AND NOTHING ELSE.
